{{PAGENAME}} are boxes of [[Farming#Improvable_Crops|improvable crops]] or other [[items]], created at the [[crate factory]] in the [[workyard]]. They are available to be built after you solve the [[Merchant#Trade license|trade license quest]].

To sell them, they have to be transported to the [[trade Office|trade office]] in the [[village]]. There, they need to be put on [[pallet]]s, which causes the crates to be sold automatically by the [[merchant]] every {{day|gluttony}}.

You can haul your crates manually to the village or build a [[crate factory]] and assign a {{item|zombie}} to the related [[porter station]] in the [[barn cellar]] to have it done for you.
